biggest_catch: You must qualify through unpaid 'ticket jobs' before you unlock paying jobs — and paying jobs are first-come, first-served, so they vanish fast in busy markets.
catches: New agents start on unpaid 'ticket jobs' to qualify for paying jobs (official app listing).
Jobs are usually first come, first serve — you have to check the app often.
Submissions that are not approved earn nothing; Field Agent does not pay for denied work.
GPS/location services must be on; you must be at the correct store location.
Only the client's approval triggers payment; payout is real cash (not points) via PayPal.

steps: Download the Field Agent app and register (a Payment Account is created automatically).
Complete unpaid 'ticket jobs' to qualify for paying jobs.
Reserve a paying job (first come, first serve), complete it at the correct location within the time frame.
Submission passes quality review; funds are added to your Field Agent balance.
Disburse from your Payment Account to PayPal.
timing: Once your submission is approved, funds go to your Field Agent balance, ready to deposit/cash out to PayPal.
who_pays: The brands posting jobs on Field Agent pay you per approved job; approved money lands in your Field Agent balance, then you cash it out.
who_qualifies: A smartphone with GPS/location on and a PayPal account for cashout. US agents (separate Field Agent apps exist for Australia and the UK).
work_available: First-come, first-served — paying jobs vanish fast in busy markets, so you have to check the app often. New agents must first complete unpaid 'ticket jobs' to qualify for paying work.
what_gets_accepted: Only approved submissions earn — Field Agent does not pay for denied work. You must be at the correct store location with location services on.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: the qualifying 'ticket jobs' you must do before paying jobs unlock, travel to stores, and any rejected submission.
when_cash_arrives: Once your submission is approved, the money goes to your Field Agent balance, ready to deposit or cash out to PayPal as real cash (not points).

repeatable.cadence: New jobs post in the app — complete a job, get approved, funds hit your balance, and claim the next one.
